summary: The proof is correct. For almost every reflected pair of fibers, each coordinate overlap averaged over the two core choices is exactly the arithmetic mean of the corresponding factors of B. Independence across coordinates and AM-GM therefore give average reflected overlap at least B using the assumed reflection invariance of B. A maximizing core vertex yields a reflection-invariant submeasure of mass at least M, so every closed halfspace containing its center has original mixed mass at least M/2. Finally, the absolutely continuous centrally symmetric B-measure has depth M/2 at the symmetry center, while opposite halfspaces through any point bound every point's depth by M/2.
